drivingQuestion: Why does an animal require two simanim, a bird only one, and a fish none at all?
outcomeNote: An expository unit with a supporting proof and no dispute: it supplies the rationale for the gradation bar Kappara derived from ״זאת תורת הבהמה והעוף״ at the close of the preceding sugya.

segments.he: דָּרַשׁ עוֹבֵר גָּלִילָאָה: בְּהֵמָה שֶׁנִּבְרֵאת מִן הַיַּבָּשָׁה – הֶכְשֵׁרָהּ בִּשְׁנֵי סִימָנִים, דָּגִים שֶׁנִּבְרְאוּ מִן הַמַּיִם – הֶכְשֵׁירָן בִּוְלֹא כְּלוּם, עוֹף שֶׁנִּבְרָא מִן הָרְקָק – הֶכְשֵׁרוֹ בְּסִימָן אֶחָד. אָמַר רַב שְׁמוּאֵל קַפּוֹטְקָאָה: תֵּדַע, שֶׁהֲרֵי עוֹפוֹת יֵשׁ לָהֶן קַשְׂקֶשֶׂת בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם כַּדָּגִים.
segments.en: The Gemara relates that «a passerby from the Galilee taught: Fitness» for consumption of «animals, which were created from the» dry «land,» is accomplished «through» cutting «two simanim,» the gullet and the windpipe. «Fitness» for consumption of «fish, which were created from the water,» is accomplished «with nothing,» as no slaughter is required. «Fitness» for consumption of «birds, which were created from mud [harekak],» a combination of dry land and water, is accomplished «through» cutting «one siman. Rav Shmuel of Cappadocia says: Know» that «birds» were created from a combination of dry land and water, «as they have scales on their feet like fish.»

moves.summary: supplies a rationale for the three-way gradation of slaughter just established: fitness follows the element of creation
moves.about: the exposition that each creature's fitness for consumption tracks the element it was created from

moves.summary: proves that birds come from mud from the scales on their feet
moves.about: that birds were created from mud, a mixture of land and water, and so are made fit by one siman
